# RecurSaathi

> RecurSaathi is a payment-recovery tool for Indian subscription businesses. It detects failed card and UPI AutoPay payments, retries inside RBI-allowed windows, sends WhatsApp and email nudges with one-tap UPI payment links, and tracks overdue invoices and dormant customers. It is in early access; pricing is finalized at launch. RecurSaathi never holds customer money: payments settle directly into the business's own Razorpay account or UPI ID.

- [Home](https://recursathii.onrender.com/): product overview, pricing, FAQ

- [Free failed payment loss calculator](https://recursathii.onrender.com/failed-payment-calculator): estimate monthly revenue lost to failed card and UPI AutoPay payments; runs in the browser, nothing stored

## Facts
- Built for: edtech and coaching, fitness studios, D2C subscriptions, agencies
- Works without a gateway (manual UPI QR mode); Razorpay AutoPay retries when connected
- RBI-compliant retries: 24-hour, 72-hour and day-7 windows, routed by decline code, never blind-retried on invalid cards
- Enterprise adds: multi-branch management (up to 5 branches), custom automation rules, REST API with keys, custom PDF reports, manager permissions, predictive revenue leak and daily insights (rule-based, on the business's own records)
- Contact: recursathii.onrender.com/contact

- /upi-autopay-failure-decoder: decline-code decoder with plain-English meaning and the right next step.
